level.theme: Ominous volcanic environment with shifting terrain, eerie glowing fissures, and distant thunderous rumblings.
level.setting: A cursed volcano where the earth itself is alive and hostile, with magma rivers, obsidian spires, and ash-filled skies.
level.player_weapon: Molten Axe (default) / Lava Staff (unlocked via pickups)

encounters.location: Lava Chamber of the Forgotten Core

enemy.name: Magma Warden
enemy.weakness: Molten Axe (default weapon, deals 50% more damage)

encounters.hazard: Lava geysers erupt when enemy is attacked, reducing player health by 10 per hit.

pickup.name: Crystallized Lava Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks 'Fissure Strike' ability (creates damaging cracks in terrain, 30% chance to crit).

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Magma Warden collapses the lava chamber ceiling, revealing a path to the next area.

enemy.name: Lava Elemental
enemy.weakness: Crystallized Lava Core (deals 75% more damage when used in 'Fissure Strike')

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rock formations block paths, requiring the player to use 'Fissure Strike' to clear them.

pickup.name: Volcanic Resonance Crystal
pickup.effect: Unlocks 'Magma Overload' ability (temporarily increases weapon damage by 100% for 10 seconds).

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Lava Elemental causes the cavern walls to quake, exposing a hidden staircase leading to the volcano's heart.

boss.name: Molten Titan
boss.weakness: Volcanic Resonance Crystal (required to trigger 'Magma Overload' in Phase 3, deals 200% damage).
boss.victory_condition: Reduce health to 0 using 'Magma Overload' during Phase 3.

level.objective: Navigate a volatile volcanic realm to stop an ancient molten titan from erupting, requiring strategic use of pickups and geomantic abilities.
level.reward: Volcanic Core Relic (grants permanent +20% geomantic power and unlocks 'Earthquake' ultimate ability).

level.theme: Chaotic volcanic environment with dynamic hazards and escalating enemy threats.
level.setting: A labyrinth of magma channels, unstable rock formations, and active volcanic vents.
level.player_weapon: Inferno Staff (Fire-based magic with a charged 'Magma Shockwave' attack)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rock pillars and erupting geysers

pickup.name: Magma Core
pickup.effect: Boosts fire magic damage by 30% for 90 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Golem causes a tremor, revealing a path to the Lava Serpent's lair.

encounters.hazard: Slippery lava rivers and explosive magma bubbles

pickup.name: Volcanic Ash
pickup.effect: Creates a temporary cooling zone to weaken fire-resistant enemies

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Serpent's molten scales with Magma Core opens a fissure leading to the boss chamber.

encounters.hazard: Unstable terrain, falling boulders, and erupting magma geysers

pickup.name: Volcanic Core
pickup.effect: Permanent upgrade to Inferno Staff's Magma Shockwave

encounters.trigger: Using Volcanic Ash on the Titan's weak spot (its core) triggers a final eruption, forcing the player to navigate collapsing terrain.

boss.name: Lava Titan
boss.victory_condition: Use Volcanic Ash to target the Titan's core while avoiding its molten strikes.

level.objective: Survive the chaotic volcanic caverns and defeat the Lava Titan by leveraging pickups and your pyromancer abilities.
level.reward: Volcanic Core (permanent weapon upgrade) and access to the next level, 'Ashen Peaks'.

level.theme: Tense, high-stakes progression through unstable terrain with time-sensitive hazards and puzzle-like enemy weaknesses.
level.setting: A labyrinth of magma rivers, obsidian walls, and geysers that erupt unpredictably, forcing the player to balance combat with environmental navigation.
level.player_weapon: Holy Flame Mace (emits radiant light, deals fire damage, and purifies lava)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rock pillars that force the player to dodge at timed intervals.

pickup.name: Light Crystal
pickup.effect: Temporarily enhances the Holy Flame Mace's damage by 50% and reveals hidden paths.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Golem causes the lava flow to reroute, exposing a path to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Periodic eruptions of toxic gas that reduce player stamina and vision.

pickup.name: Volcanic Core
pickup.effect: When combined with the Light Crystal, it creates a powerful explosive attack against the final boss.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Wraith with the Light Crystal unlocks a sealed door leading to the boss arena.

boss.name: Volcanic Titan
boss.weakness: Combination of the Holy Flame Mace's light damage and the Volcanic Core's explosive power
boss.victory_condition: Deal 100 damage using the Holy Flame Mace and Volcanic Core combo

level.objective: Navigate a volatile volcanic cavern to reach the heart of the volcano and defeat the molten titan threatening the region.
level.reward: Inferno Relic (permanent buff: +20% fire damage and +15% resistance to lava hazards)

level.theme: Desolate and oppressive, with the environment actively attacking the player through hazards and enemy behavior.
level.setting: A dying volcano with cracked earth, toxic fumes, and ruins of a forgotten civilization swallowed by lava.
level.player_weapon: Crimson Cleaver (a serrated greatsword that ignites on contact with magma)

encounters.location: Ashen Caverns (collapsed tunnels with glowing magma veins)

enemy.name: Lava Warden
enemy.weakness: Crimson Cleaver's igniting edge (must be charged by standing in magma pools)

encounters.hazard: Molten rock falls from collapsing ceiling

pickup.name: Corrosive Acid Vial
pickup.effect: Reduces enemy armor by 50% for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Crack the magma vein wall with the Cleaver to unlock the path to the Magma Serpent's nest.

encounters.location: Magma Serpent's Nest (a cavern with geysers and molten pools)

enemy.name: Magma Serpent
enemy.weakness: Corrosive Acid Vial (must be thrown into its eye socket to bypass its heat resistance)

encounters.hazard: Explosive magma geysers triggered by enemy movement

pickup.name: Cooled Magma Core
pickup.effect: Temporarily grants immunity to fire damage and allows the player to deal 200% damage to the Molten Titan

encounters.trigger: Destroy the serpent's nest, causing the caldera floor to collapse and reveal the Molten Titan's chamber.

encounters.location: The Caldera (a massive lava-filled crater with a floating obsidian platform)

enemy.name: Molten Titan
enemy.weakness: Cooled Magma Core (must be inserted into the Titan's chest to activate a vulnerability)

encounters.hazard: Lava waves and falling rocks from the collapsing obsidian platform

pickup.name: Volcanic Ash Amulet
pickup.effect: Absorbs 30% of damage taken and converts it into a temporary shield

encounters.trigger: The battle begins automatically after the previous encounter. The Titan's core must be activated using the Cooled Magma Core.

boss.name: Molten Titan
boss.weakness: Cooled Magma Core (only usable after obtaining it from the Magma Serpent)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Titan's core using the Cooled Magma Core while dodging its lava projectiles.

level.objective: Survive the volcanic wasteland and defeat the Molten Titan, the guardian of the caldera.
level.reward: Volcanic Ash Amulet (grants fire resistance and a 20% chance to reflect damage back to attackers)

level.theme: Mysterious ancient forge with glowing magma veins and cryptic runes that pulse with energy
level.setting: A labyrinth of basalt tunnels, geothermal vents, and a central magma pool where the Sentinel guards a dormant forge.
level.player_weapon: Plasma Cannon (primary weapon) with a 'Thermal Overcharge' upgrade

encounters.hazard: Periodic lava geysers erupting from the floor

pickup.name: Thermal Conductor
pickup.effect: Absorbs heat to cool nearby mechanisms (used in later encounters)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Golem reveals a hidden passage sealed by molten rock, which the Thermal Conductor can cool to unlock.

encounters.hazard: Toxic gas clouds that reduce player vision

pickup.name: Geo-Resonator
pickup.effect: Detects seismic activity and weak points in rock/armor

encounters.trigger: After absorbing the serpent's core, the Geo-Resonator vibrates, revealing a tremor leading to the volcano's core.

boss.name: Volcanic Sentinel
boss.victory_condition: Weaken its shield with Geo-Resonator, then destroy its core with Plasma Cannon

level.objective: Navigate a volatile volcanic labyrinth to reach the heart of the mountain, uncovering ancient secrets while surviving environmental hazards and mysterious guardians.
level.reward: Volcanic Core Blueprint (unlocks new artificer tech)

level.theme: Eerie volcanic labyrinth with ghostly apparitions, unstable terrain, and haunting whispers echoing through fissures.
level.setting: A corrupted volcano with glowing magma rivers, sulfuric mist, and crumbling obsidian structures. The air hums with unstable energy, and distant rumbling suggests imminent eruptions.
level.player_weapon: Stormcaller's Tempest Staff (channel lightning and manipulate weather)

encounters.hazard: Flickering ghostly flames that cause confusion

pickup.name: Volcanic Storm Crystal
pickup.effect: Boosts lightning damage by 40% for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Ash Warden collapses a rock barrier, revealing a path to the Lava Forge.

enemy.name: Molten Colossus
enemy.weakness: Volcanic Storm Crystal (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Lava geysers erupting randomly, dealing burn damage

pickup.name: Thunder Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks 'Tempest Barrage' ability (3 charged lightning strikes)

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Molten Colossus causes the forge's ceiling to collapse, triggering a surge of static energy that awakens the next foe.

encounters.hazard: Electrically charged ground that drains health over time

pickup.name: Stormforged Lens
pickup.effect: Allows vision through volcanic ash and reveals hidden paths

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Shadowforge destabilizes the volcano's core, causing the ground to rupture and expose the final boss.

boss.name: Eruption Seraph
boss.weakness: Volcanic Storm Crystal (pickup from first encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the seraph's lava heart by channeling lightning through the Volcanic Storm Crystal

level.objective: Navigate a volatile volcanic labyrinth, uncovering ancient storm magic to defeat a malevolent force corrupting the land.
level.reward: Stormforged Armor (reduces elemental damage by 30%) and a permanent damage boost to lightning attacks

level.setting: A playful volcanic landscape with colorful lava geysers, bouncing magma rocks, and giggling fire creatures. The environment shifts between hot and cool areas depending on pickups used.
level.player_weapon: Flame-Forged Staff (can be upgraded with elemental pickups)

encounters.hazard: Lava geysers erupt when enemy attacks, reducing player health by 5

pickup.name: Cooling Crystal
pickup.effect: Freeze enemies for 3 seconds when used

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Lava Pup causes the nearby lava rocks to cool and form a bridge to the next area.

encounters.hazard: The ground becomes unstable, causing random falls that reduce health by 10

pickup.name: Pyro Feather
pickup.effect: Increase Flame-Forged Staff damage by 5 for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Magma Slime releases a plume of steam that awakens the dormant Volcanic Hydra in the final chamber.

boss.name: Volcanic Hydra
boss.victory_condition: Reduce health to 0 using the Cooling Crystal to freeze its heads

level.objective: Navigate the whimsical volcanic terrain and defeat the Volcanic Hydra, using pickups to overcome challenges.
level.reward: Volcanic Core (upgrade Flame-Forged Staff to 'Molten Staff' with increased fire damage and elemental effects)

level.setting: A dormant volcano with still lava lakes, rhythmic geysers, and mist-shrouded cliffs. The environment feels peaceful but hides dangers beneath its calm surface.

enemy.name: Lava Golem
enemy.weakness: Chronoglass Sword's time-slow ability (target its exposed core during 3-second pauses)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rock pillars triggered by golem's movement

pickup.name: Time Crystal
pickup.effect: Disrupts time loops; used to free the Time-Locked Sentinel

encounters.trigger: Golem's core pulses rhythmically, revealing a path to the next area when defeated

enemy.name: Time-Locked Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Time Crystal (breaks its infinite attack loop)

encounters.hazard: Repeating lava floods synchronized with the sentinel's loop

pickup.name: Temporal Lens
pickup.effect: Highlights enemy weak points; reveals Chronophage's core during boss fight

encounters.trigger: After breaking the sentinel's loop, a hidden passage opens to the boss arena

enemy.name: Molten Chronophage
enemy.weakness: Temporal Lens (reveals core vulnerability during phase transitions)

encounters.hazard: Time distortions causing random slowdowns and speedups

pickup.name: Eternal Flame (optional)
pickup.effect: Restores 50% health; found in the boss's remains

encounters.trigger: The Temporal Lens is required to identify the boss's core during its 5-second phase shift

boss.name: Molten Chronophage
boss.weakness: Temporal Lens (mandatory to see core during phase transition)
boss.victory_condition: Strike the core with Chronoglass Sword during the 5-second window revealed by the Temporal Lens

level.objective: Navigate the serene volcanic expanse, mastering time to overcome temporal guardians and the molten Chronophage.
level.reward: Chrono-Resonance Amulet (increases time-slow duration by 2 seconds)

level.theme: Serene celestial landscapes with soft glowing light, floating islands, and ambient choral music that crescendos during the boss fight.
level.setting: A floating temple surrounded by stars, with each encounter area connected by bridges of light that react to the player's actions.
level.player_weapon: Divine Lightbrand (a radiant sword that emits healing light)

encounters.hazard: Floating light barriers that temporarily drain 10% stamina

pickup.name: Celestial Shard
pickup.effect: Increases Divine Lightbrand's damage by 20% for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Sentinel, the garden's barriers dissolve, revealing a path to the crystalline corridor.

encounters.hazard: Reflective crystals that amplify enemy attacks by 15% if the player is not holding the Celestial Shard

pickup.name: Divine Relic of Aether
pickup.effect: Restores 30% health and grants temporary immunity to status effects

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Shadowweaver causes the corridor to collapse, forcing the player into the final chamber.

encounters.location: The Chamber of the Celestial Dragon

enemy.name: Stellar Dragoon (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Divine Relic of Aether's resonance when combined with the Celestial Shard

encounters.hazard: Gravity wells that pull the player toward the center of the chamber, dealing 10 damage per second

pickup.name: Astral Crown
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to summon a temporary light shield that reflects 50% of incoming damage

encounters.trigger: The Dragoon's defeat triggers a celestial aurora, rewarding the player with the Astral Crown and restoring the sanctum's peace.

boss.name: Stellar Dragoon
boss.weakness: Divine Relic of Aether's resonance when paired with the Celestial Shard
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Dragoon's core by combining the Divine Relic of Aether with the Celestial Shard during its vulnerable phase (when its scales are briefly unguarded).

level.objective: Navigate the Celestial Sanctum to restore balance by confronting corrupted celestial entities and the final guardian of the realm.
level.reward: Astral Crown (permanent ability to summon light shields) and full restoration of the Celestial Sanctum's serene harmony.

level.theme: Celestial ruins with shifting constellations, time rifts, and ancient alien technology. The environment flickers between eras, creating a sense of disorientation and wonder.
level.setting: A floating nexus of time, surrounded by black holes and nebulae. The air hums with echoes of forgotten civilizations.
level.player_weapon: Chronomancer's Staff (manipulates time, creates temporal rifts)

encounters.hazard: Time loops force the player to repeat sections unless the Time Crystal is used to break the cycle.

pickup.name: Time Crystal (Pickup A)
pickup.effect: Disrupts temporal enemies, temporarily halving their damage output.

encounters.trigger: Using the Time Crystal unlocks a hidden portal to the Celestial Vault, revealing the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: The Sentinel’s shield reflects 50% of all damage unless the Time Crystal is activated to destabilize it.

pickup.name: Celestial Key (Pickup B)
pickup.effect: Unlocks the door to the boss chamber and disrupts the boss’s core during phase 2.

encounters.trigger: The Celestial Key is required to open the sealed portal to the boss arena.

encounters.hazard: The boss alternates between phases: Phase 1 (rapid temporal attacks), Phase 2 (shielded core requiring the Celestial Key), and Phase 3 (time-locked arena).

pickup.name: Chrono Core (Pickup C)
pickup.effect: Restores 200 health and temporarily boosts the player’s staff damage by 50% (obtained after defeating the boss).

encounters.trigger: The Celestial Key must be used during Phase 2 to expose the boss’s core, enabling a final strike.

boss.name: Celestial Devourer
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core during Phase 2 using the Celestial Key (Pickup B).

level.objective: Navigate the Temporal Nexus, defeat three celestial adversaries, and confront the final boss using pickups obtained from prior encounters.
level.reward: Chrono Core (Pickup C) and access to the next level, 'The Void Beyond.'

level.theme: A dark, star-filled void with jagged celestial rocks, flickering nebulae, and haunting cosmic sounds.
level.setting: A fractured celestial realm where the laws of physics are unstable, and the sky pulses with ominous light.
level.player_weapon: Shadowblade (a weapon that manipulates shadow energy, with a 'Dark Veil' ability to cloak the player temporarily)

enemy.name: Celestial Warden
enemy.weakness: Shadowblade's 'Dark Veil' ability (player's weapon's shadow manipulation)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing starfields that deal 20 damage per second if the player is exposed.

pickup.name: Starforged Shard
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to disrupt void-based enemies (used in the next encounter).

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Warden causes a rift to open, revealing the path to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Gravity wells that pull the player into the void, dealing 30 damage and slowing movement by 50%.

pickup.name: Celestial Core
pickup.effect: Absorbs the Eclipse Sovereign's energy attacks, converting them into healing (used in the boss fight).

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Void Serpent triggers a celestial alignment, activating the final portal to the boss arena.

enemy.name: Eclipse Sovereign
enemy.weakness: Celestial Core (pickup from the second encounter)

encounters.hazard: Periodic supernova explosions that deal 50 damage to the player every 30 seconds.

pickup.name: Eclipse Sigil
pickup.effect: Permanently increases Shadowblade damage by 20%.

encounters.trigger: The Celestial Core must be activated during the boss fight to weaken the Sovereign's shield.

boss.name: Eclipse Sovereign
boss.weakness: Celestial Core (must be activated during the fight)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Sovereign by using the Celestial Core to bypass its shield, then landing the final blow with the Shadowblade.

level.objective: Navigate the Celestial Abyss to confront the Eclipse Sovereign, using pickups and weapon mastery to survive brutal encounters.
level.reward: Eclipse Sigil (permanent weapon upgrade) and access to the Celestial Expanse zone.

level.theme: Whimsical celestial environment with shifting constellations, floating islands, and glowing flora. The level evolves as the player progresses, with each pickup altering the environment's appearance.

encounters.hazard: Floating debris that randomly teleports the player

pickup.name: Prismatic Lens
pickup.effect: Reveals hidden paths and weak points in enemies

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Sprout, the Prismatic Lens unlocks a celestial beacon that lights the path to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Gravity fluctuations that invert the player's movement direction

pickup.name: Celestial Core
pickup.effect: Deals 25 damage when thrown; temporarily grants immunity to illusions

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Serpent aligns the celestial beacon, creating a portal to the final chamber.

boss.name: Celestial Mirror King
boss.weakness: Celestial Core (ignites the core of its illusory body)

pickup.effect: Powers the Stormcaller's Staff to unleash a planet-shaking lightning strike (1-use)

boss.name: The Chaos Titan

boss.victory_condition: Use the Celestial Core to power the Stormcaller's Staff and land a final lightning strike

level.objective: Navigate a collapsing celestial rift while harnessing storm power to defeat three chaotic entities and a final boss whose weakness is tied to a critical pickup.
level.reward: The Stormcaller's Celestial Staff + Celestial Core + 1000 XP

level.theme: Desolate celestial ruins with flickering starlight and crumbling alien architecture
level.setting: A derelict space station orbiting a dying star, with gravity anomalies and unstable energy fields
level.player_weapon: Celestial Bow (fires starbolts that can illuminate darkness and disrupt energy fields)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling fragments

pickup.name: Starshard

enemy.weakness: Kinetic energy (requires Starshard to power the Celestial Bow's 'Kinetic Shot' mode)

level.objective: Navigate the derelict celestial station 'The Astral Wastes' while uncovering its secrets and surviving its guardians. The final goal is to confront the corrupted celestial entity at the heart of the station.

level.setting: Derelict celestial fortress in a nebula, with shattered planets and eerie, glowing corridors. Static crackles in the air, and distant echoes of voices haunt the void.

encounters.hazard: Static electricity surges

pickup.name: Celestial Core
pickup.effect: Power source for devices; doubles energy weapon damage for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Inserting the Celestial Core into a console opens a portal to the next area.

enemy.name: Void Eater
enemy.weakness: Celestial Core (focused energy beam disrupts its form)

encounters.hazard: Light-absorbing darkness reduces visibility

pickup.name: Gravity Anchor

encounters.hazard: Radiation storms and collapsing planetary fragments

encounters.trigger: Deploying the Gravity Anchor during the boss fight exposes its core; destroying it with the Plasma Welder triggers the Stabilizer Module's activation, saving the station.

boss.name: Nova Core
